
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(Lahman)

ui <- page_sidebar(
  # title of the page
  title = "title panel",
  
  # sidebar code here
  sidebar = sidebar("sidebar", position = "right",
    selectInput("Batting", "Batting", choices = names(Batting)),
  ),
  card(
    card_header(),
    
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$Batting <- renderPrint({
    input$Batting
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server=server)
```
